hooks.command: ./scripts/loom-python --ready --script ../hooks/agy_adapter.py push-gate; status=$?; if [ "$status" -eq 86 ]; then printf '{"decision":"allow","reason":"loom: publication hook failed (checker runtime unavailable; run loom-python --repair in an agent station); allowing."}\n'; exit 0; fi; exit "$status"

PreInvocation.command: ./scripts/loom-python --ready --script ../hooks/agy_adapter.py pre-invocation; status=$?; if [ "$status" -eq 86 ]; then printf '{}\n'; exit 0; fi; exit "$status"
